card.text: M80 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 10,340 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 80 is a globular cluster located approximately 32,600 light-years (10,000 pc) from Earth in the constellation Scorpius.

introduction.text: M80 is drawn as 335 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: Discovered by Charles Messier in 1781, it is one of the densest globular clusters in the Milky Way, containing several hundred thousand stars within a spatial diameter of about 95 light-years.
